name: @pipeworx/mcp-diff

tools.name: diff_lines
tools.description: Compute a line-level diff between two texts (keyless, offline). Returns the change list (equal/add/remove), an added/removed/unchanged summary, and a unified-diff-style string with +/- prefixes.

context.description: If true, include unchanged lines in the unified output (default true).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-diff forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the diff pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
